deployments_detail.use: Conversational AI search on realestate.com.au and realAssist, an OpenAI-powered AI companion helping homeowners understand property valuations

realAssist - an AI-powered conversational companion (powered by OpenAI) for logged-in homeowners tracking their property, letting them ask why their realEstimate valuation changed and get tailored explanations and next-step recommendations. Launched Dec 2025 on realestate.com.au. [OpenAI]
deployments_detail.value: drove property attribute updates on 140,000+ homes in the past year; one in three Australian homes tracked

deployments_detail.use: Natural language / conversational AI search on realestate.com.au, letting users phrase intuitive queries (e.g. 'homes with a pool and double garage in Kew') and, in a conversational-search beta, engage a multi-turn AI agent. Expanded to 50% of site visitors after a year-long pilot. [OpenAI; Google (Gemini)]
deployments_detail.value: natural language search expanded to 50% of visitors; conversational search beta to 10% of visitors

deployments_detail.use: First real estate app for ChatGPT, letting logged-in ChatGPT users search for and view realestate.com.au property listings (photos, features, descriptions, pricing) via conversational language and link back to full listings and agent contact. [OpenAI]

PropTrack Automated Valuation Model (AVM), the ML engine behind realEstimate, rebuilt with Thoughtworks on AWS using CD4ML and Metaflow to deliver instant property value estimates at scale. [Thoughtworks; AWS; Metaflow]
deployments_detail.value: 12% accuracy improvement (AVM values within 10% of sale price); model training cut from 3-4 days to 5 hours; prediction explanations from 1-2 days to 15 minutes

deployments_detail.use: PropTrack Buyer Impact Model - an AI model analysing 25 buyer behavioural signals (saves, shares, time on listing, image engagement, agent contact, inspections) across 1.3M sales to predict which listings sell; live on realestate.com.au and property.com.au. [none]
deployments_detail.value: analysed 1.3 million sales (Aug 2023-Nov 2025); buyers view 28x more images than non-buyers; independently validated by Deloitte

deployments_detail.use: Generative AI 'Top Feature' summaries for Suggested Properties on the realestate.com.au home-screen carousel, sending listing descriptions to the ChatGPT API to surface key attributes for each recommended property. [OpenAI (ChatGPT API)]

AI-powered image tagging/scoring that analyses listing photos to identify property attributes, aesthetic appeal and renovation status, feeding the AVM and improving valuation accuracy (PropTrack image scoring). [PropTrack (in-house)]
AI-generated property highlights that automatically surface key features and amenities of a listing for quick comparison, enabling faster shortlisting and filtering on realestate.com.au. [none]

Listing optimisation (Premiere Plus) that uses AI to dynamically reorder listing photos, prioritising the most engaging visuals to increase buyer/tenant engagement - an advertising product feature for agent customers. [REA Group (in-house)]

Machine-learning matching/recommendation algorithms that match prospective vendors (sellers) with the REA agent customer that best fits their profile, and predict consumer property interests and lifecycle stage to improve recommendations. [REA Group (in-house)]

'The Chaser' - an internal AI agent used by the Customer Experience team to synthesise outstanding information requests across cross-functional teams and coordinate follow-ups at scale, with user-set guardrails on time frame and sources. [REA Group (in-house)]
